notes.title: Version 1.11 released
notes.content:
[h1]New in v1.11:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a stats window to quickly view tracked statistics
[*]Space Station 1-4 coin is a bit easier
[*]Made Silver, Gold, and Radioactive suits slightly better
[*]Slightly increased power on lower power suits
[*]Final game time is shown at ending if "Show Timers" is on
[*]Auro 1 and 2 times are shown below stars if "Show Timers" is on
[*]Fixed Auro music intro starting doubled
[*]Fixed spawn effect sometimes not disappearing after changing suits
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.091 now released
notes.content:
[h1]New in v1.091:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added gamepad recommendation at splash screen
[*]Color-coded speedrun times for current time, pb, and goal times
[*]Mission speedrun goal times are now shown in the mission pause menu if "Show Timer" is checked
[*]Added Personal Best times for all difficulties, and an option toggle to show either best PB of all difficulties or just the current
[*]Mission timers now begin when you first thrust
[*]Mission timers now reset if you die and respawn on the first platform
[*]Timer centiseconds are slightly bigger
[*]End cutscene now skippable
[*]Fixed missions deaths showing as -1 for difficulties where you haven't completed the mission yet
[*]Fixed an object duplication bug that could occur when a level loaded in a single frame
[*]Fixed a bug where the level in front wasn't being fully loaded after a respawn
[*]Fixed the visuals of the jetpack particles when rotating
[*]Fixed a couple typos
[*]Ultimo 1 coin is a bit easier
[*]Kytin 3-12 vine won't grow while you're on the platform
[*]Player hitbox for landing sideways slightly bigger/friendlier
[*]Landing upright but at an angle will now correct your x position to prevent appearing off the platform
[*]Fixed a bug where a cutscene laser door was closed after returning to that level
[/list]
